svg.title: Data flow in the reference run
svg.desc: 8 companies become 29 needs, up to 4 candidates per need, 66 profiles, 32 pairs and 7 no-match outcomes, 7 chosen pairs, and 6 accepted proposals plus 1 for a person, written to out/golden. The Critic checks every need, profile, pair and proposal; the Funding Scout adds EU calls to each chosen pair.
